message:
The other day, we were rushing out the door for a family trip when we realized we’d forgotten our important documents. After a quick scramble, we remembered the go-bag we had packed a while back. It had our IDs, insurance info, and even some basic snacks for the road! 👜 

That little bag, tucked away and mostly forgotten, turned out to be a small win that saved our day. It’s a gentle reminder that even the simplest preparations can make a big difference. 

What’s your favorite tip for being ready when life throws a curveball?
